snippet.title: My Child New Beginnings - Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Preorder now on Google Play: 
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.SareptaStudio.MyChildNewBeginnings

Preorder on iTunes:
https://apps.apple.com/us/app/my-child-new-beginnings/id6747576464

Care for your child and rebuild life after trauma. 
My Child New Beginnings is an evolving nurture game where your choices shape your child’s future. Play as the adoptive parent of Klaus or Karin - a child struggling with trauma. Help them heal by creating a safe and loving environment. Share meaningful moments and guide them on their journey.

For more information: mychildnewbeginnings.com
